description: List messages in this farm's QuailOS Email Assistant inbox (the mailbox the farm connected in Office > Email Assistant: Forwarding Bridge and/or IMAP accounts). Newest first. Owner/admin AI keys only. Returns id, threadId, from, subject, snippet, date, folder, read flag. Page with nextCursor passed back verbatim with the same filters.

cursor.description: Optional: the nextCursor string from the previous list_emails response, passed verbatim with the same filters

folder.description: Folder to list (default INBOX). ALL = every folder.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive text match on subject, sender, recipients and snippet (max 200 chars)

since.description: Optional ISO date/datetime: only messages on/after this time

until.description: Optional ISO date/datetime: only messages on/before this time (a bare YYYY-MM-DD includes that whole day, UTC)

name: list_emails
